messages:
Rae (CS): quick heads-up: OrpheusAI onboarding sees P95 spikes during nightly ingest. renewal in ~45 days, customer anxious about latency + cost. Looking for non-disruptive ops recs.
Omar (Solutions): noted. model + region? any sample prompt?
Rae (CS): running redwood/gpt-large hosted in eu-west, FP16. typical: 'extract invoice fields and 2-line summary' (~60 tokens). P95 baseline ~0.9s -> spikes to ~3.0s; spend +14%.
Jules (SE): immediate low-risk fixes: enable KV-prefix caching for invoice templates, reduce max-batch-wait for short requests, then pilot int8 for generation only. Keep extractor pinned to FP16 to protect extraction accuracy.
PilotBot: auto-suggest: 10% int8 canary for requests <1200 tokens + regional fallback to us-east on p99>2.6s. estimated token-cost -21%, P95 -27% on sampled traces.
Kai (Eng): propose concrete pilot: create variant redwood/gpt-large:int8-gen, route rule: if region==eu-west AND p99_latency>2.6s -> fallback to us-east via policy 'orpheus-fallback', traffic split 90/10 for tokens<1200, KV-prefix cache on invoice templates, tag traces 'orpheus-canary-6298765432'.
Omar (Solutions): draft customer note: 1) 48h pilot at 10% traffic, 2) quality guardrails: auto-rollback if extraction accuracy drops >0.8% OR error rate +10% in 24h, 3) we'll collect 50 random prompt snapshots and run micro-survey after 48h.
Rae (CS): please include explicit rollback SLA and contact for immediate opt-out. Customer wants transparency.
Jules (SE): SDK snippet for canary example: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-large:int8-gen","route":"orpheus-fallback","meta":{"tag":"orpheus-canary-6298765432"}}'`
PilotBot: preflight eval on 200 samples: extraction precision delta 0.3% (within tolerance), flagged 3 date-format edge cases. recommend manual review of flagged items.
Kai (Eng): Ops will run auto-eval at 48h and post results. if any extractor regression triggers, pin extractor endpoints to fp16 immediately and continue other experiments.
Omar (Solutions): I'll draft pilot plan + short slide by EOD. Rae, want me to join kickoff?
Rae (CS): yes please, 30m touchpoint tomorrow. I'll own feedback capture and the prompt snapshots. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
